members: public boolean perm\u0069ts(TelemetryEvent event) { if (event == null || event.publisherId() == null || !event.publisherId().equals(trustedPublisherId)) { return false; } if (event.schemaVersion() != 1 || event.eventKey() == null) { return false; } return event.eventKey().equals(TelemetryEvent.keyOf(event.deviceId(), event.metric(), event.tDevice(), event.revision())); }
